supported.paragraph_1: .luma mods, Riivolution packs, disc file replacements, Dolphin texture packs and replacement movies.
supported.paragraph_2: Wii code patches cannot run in a native game, and Nebula lists them at import.
supported.paragraph_3: converts a Wii mod to a .luma file and lists what it cannot use.

import.paragraph_1: Open Settings, then the MODS page.
import.paragraph_2: Choose Import file or Import folder, or drop the mod on the game window. Archives can be .zip, .7z, .rar or .tar, without a password.
import.paragraph_3: Move the mod to the list on the right. When two mods change the same file, the higher one wins.
import.paragraph_4: Choose the mod’s options, then Apply and restart Nebula.

packs.paragraph_1: Dolphin texture packs use tex1_ file names. Texture packs On loads images as needed; Preload loads all of them at startup and uses more memory.
packs.paragraph_2: Replacement movies go in the movies folder, named like the game’s videos (for example PrologueA.mp4), as MP4, MKV or WebM. 4K video needs hardware video decoding.

mod-help.paragraph_1: Turn the mods off on the MODS page (on Windows, you can also hold Shift while Nebula starts). If the problem stops, turn the mods on one at a time. Error codes NEB-M01, NEB-M02 and NEB-M03 name the mod or file involved.

footer.paragraph_1: A little closer to the stars.
